grow.title: Cora man wal tabaia
grow.body: Man Watla, man ulbanka nani bara man sturka nani ba man aihwa laka piaya ra aiwananka daukisa.

privacy.title: Man sturka wan pain diara
privacy.body: Diara apu upla piaya ra sula. Man alkisma dia sut Cora IA ra sula waia, bara pas ba utban baku sa.

mascot.title: Man pitahayam kaikas
mascot.body: Naha pitahaya ba man aihwa laka wal tabaia, panika apu, castigo apu — nibel baman pura brih.

lifeStage.title: ¿Naiwa nan piaya ra sma?
lifeStage.subtitle: Naha ra Cora ba man dukiara aiwananka daukisa. Man yawa laka wina taim bani lakaia sip sma.
lifeStage.saveError: Man piaya ba swakaia sip apia kan. Kli pruwa kaiks.

avatar.title: Man avatar ba wali
avatar.subtitle: Nicaragua tasba wina animal nani — kum ta lak alki kaikaia dukiara.
avatar.loadError: Avatar nani kaikaia sip apia kan.
avatar.emptyDescription: Piaya wina kum wali sma sip, man yawa laka wina.
avatar.saveError: Man avatar ba swakaia sip apia kan. Kli pruwa kaiks.

medicalBackground.title: Mahka siknis nani
medicalBackground.subtitle: Naha ra man wal tabaia sip yang. Opcional sa — piaya wina bapisma, man yawa laka wina.
medicalBackground.familyHistoryPlaceholder: Ulb. diabetes, tala pura kaia man kumi laka ra...
medicalBackground.saveError: Man mahka siknis nani swakaia sip apia kan. Kli pruwa kaiks.

mascotIntro.title: Man pitahayam kaikas
mascotIntro.body: Aihwa laka bani ulbanka wal tabaia — panika apu, castigo apu. Nibel wina wal sin wilras.

consent.title: Wan sturka bara Cora IA
consent.aiShareLabel: Cora IA wal sturka wali sula
consent.aiShareDescription: Pas ba utban baku sa. Man alki lakisma, Cora ba man ulbanka wina alki kaikaia sip sa — permiso apu apia baku apia.
consent.disclaimer: Cora siknis marikras, daktar wal aisi kaikaia wina apia sa.
consent.saveError: Man alki laka nani swakaia sip apia kan. Kli pruwa kaiks.
